item.title: River Water Quality 1990–2018 — Biochemical oxygen demand (BOD)
item.description: Per-monitoring-site mean biochemical oxygen demand (bod) for the 2010–2018 period, derived from DAERA's River Water Quality Monitoring 1990–2018 dataset (~141 K sample-time records aggregated to 572 active sites). Site points are coloured by mean value over the period; click any site for its full statistics including min, max, and most recent measurement. Older or full-time-series data is available as the per-parameter umbrella card linked from the catalogue.
